主要内容: ASML Holding N.V. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on February 8, 2017, as part of its compliance with U.S. securities regulations. The filing includes the Statutory Annual Report 2016, Integrated Report 2016, and a press release announcing the publication of the annual reports. The report was signed by Peter T.F.M. Wennink, the Chief Executive Officer of ASML Holding N.V. This filing is a routine disclosure requirement for foreign issuers under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The company is a leading manufacturer of semiconductor equipment, and its financial disclosures are relevant to investors and stakeholders.
